name: unsafe fn decrement_strong_count (ptr : * const T)
rule: If ptr was obtained through Rc<U>::into_raw and U is sized, U must have the same size and alignment as T for Rc<T>::decrement_strong_count(ptr) to be safe.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Rc < T > { unsafe fn decrement_strong_count (ptr : * const T) }
